transformation_flows.source_description: FlowX test TC-PRM-006: DELIBERATELY INVALID spec -- transformation_sql references ${dept_code}, but pipeline_parameters (above) only declares region_code and omits dept_code entirely. Expected to be REJECTED at onboarding validation time by onboarding/spec_validator.py::_validate_sql_syntax, which calls transformation/parameters.py::substitute_dynamic_parameters and lets its FrameworkConfigError ('Transformation SQL references undefined parameter(s): [...]') surface as a collected validation error, so 02_onboarding_engine.py raises OnboardingValidationError and never reaches upsert_transformation_flow_spec. See docs/70_tc_prm_006.md.
transformation_flows.transformation_sql: SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department_id FROM employee_raw_input WHERE department_id = ${dept_code} AND region = ${region_code}
